summary: Iter27 (Hapus Duplikat Soal + Impor dengan deteksi duplikat + kolom wajib ketat): Backend 12/12 pytest pass, UI flows for both DuplicateDialog and TryoutBuilder import preview verified end-to-end. Preview/validate endpoints correctly mark within-file duplicates ('Sama dengan baris N') and existing-in-tryout duplicates ('sudah ada'), counted in 'duplicates' not 'invalid' (ok=false, error=None). import-rows and legacy /questions/import skip duplicates and return a duplicates list. Missing required column -> 400 'Kolom wajib tidak ada di berkas: option_e'. Empty points/competency/tingkat -> per-row error. Template XLSX required headers have blue fill (0E7490) and Petunjuk sheet contains WAJIB/OPSIONAL/Duplikat rows. GET /admin/question-bank/duplicates groups by _dup_key, computes same_tryout flag, includes tryout_title/has_explanation/tryout_has_results. POST /admin/questions/bulk-delete deletes selected ids; empty list -> 400. UI DuplicateDialog opens from ManageTryouts open-duplicates, shows dup-total, dup-same-tryout chip, dup-group-{i}, dup-check-{id}; dup-auto-pick selects extras (keeps 1 per tryout); dup-delete -> ConfirmButton 'Hapus' triggers bulk-delete and reload. ImportPreviewDialog shows import-duplicate-count chip and purple duplicate status rows.
critical_code_review_comments: _dup_key normalises whitespace+case for text and sorts option texts — robust canonical key for cross-tryout duplicate detection.
_preview_payload separates duplicates from invalid (dup rows have ok=false but error=None) matching UX spec; counts valid/invalid/duplicates independently.
_insert_rows re-checks existing keys at insert-time (not relying on preview) so race-safe when two admins import simultaneously; also prevents within-batch repeats via existing.add(k).
question_duplicates endpoint is O(N) over all questions and uses a single $in aggregate for attempts — scales fine up to the 50k limit; consider pagination later.
Template xlsx: required columns filled 0E7490 (teal) and optional E2E8F0 (gray) — matches design intent and renders correctly in openpyxl load.
DuplicateDialog.extrasOf preferentially keeps the item with has_explanation per tryout — matches spec 'prefer one with pembahasan'.
ImportPreviewDialog shows duplicate chip only when data.duplicates > 0 (conditional render) — clean UI when no duplicates.
No ObjectId leakage: question_duplicates projection excludes _id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows (duplicate dialog + import preview duplicate marking)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ITER27_DUP and TEST_ITER27_DUP2 standalone tryouts (cleaned up via fixtures/finally). UI test creates TEST_ITER27_UI tryout with 2 identical questions, cleans up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter27 fully verified. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/questions/import/preview?tryout_id=, POST /api/admin/questions/import/validate?tryout_id=, POST /api/admin/tryouts/{id}/questions/import-rows, legacy POST /api/admin/tryouts/{id}/questions/import, GET /api/admin/question-bank/duplicates, POST /api/admin/questions/bulk-delete. UI selectors: open-duplicates, duplicate-dialog, dup-total, dup-same-tryout, dup-auto-pick, dup-group-{i}, dup-check-{id}, dup-delete + AlertDialog 'Hapus'. ImportPreviewDialog adds import-duplicate-count chip. Note: manual POST /admin/tryouts/{id}/questions still allows exact-text duplicates (by design, per agent-to-agent note), so UI tests use that path to seed duplicate pairs.
